# Behringer UMC204HD (USB 1397:0508), from https://github.com/alsa-project/alsa-ucm-conf/issues/177:
# names, numids and ifaces from the issue's `amixer -D hw:U192k controls`
# listing; types and values from the strace of `amixer -D hw:U192k contents`
# attached there (files/8979035/out.txt). strace cut each written line at 32
# characters, so access flags and ranges are not shown.
# usb 1397:0508
